frequency_question: How often do executive principals successfully deliver contested, high-magnitude regulatory fee increases within a 12-month delivery window?
membership_rule: Includes major fee adjustments proposed by DHS, DOL, or USCIS that exceed standard inflation adjustments by an order of magnitude; excludes routine fee schedules and non-fee regulatory changes.

cases.name: Public Charge Rule Fee/Bond Proposals (Trump Admin)
USCIS Comprehensive Fee Schedule Revisions (Trump Admin)
DHS Asylum Fee Final Rules (Prior Admin equivalents)

provenance_note: rate of 100% from only 4 case(s); too few to establish an extreme base rate -- treat as directional
coverage_note: 4 named; represents the distinct universe of major restrictive fee rules pursued under comparable executive intent.
known_gaps: Sample size is small because ultra-high fee rules of this specific magnitude are rare.
skeleton: Executive actions involving fee restructuring divided by total initiated high-magnitude fee rules
multiplier: 4 hits out of 4 attempted high-magnitude fee rules by immigration-focused agency leadership
validity_reason: Applies strictly to the duration of the current administration's executive leadership tenure and internal alignment.
